messages:
Amy L: ok team — need to lock dates for the planning summit. proposed windows: Mon Apr 14–Tue Apr 15 (1.5 days) or Thu Apr 17–Fri Apr 18. who’s blocked?
Jordan P: i'm blocked Apr 14 morning for an investor sync, prefer 17–18.
Olivia C: 17–18 works for me. happy to own prework packets and the attendee checklist.
Michael R: 17–18 also good. can we add a customer panel session? we got 3 asks from enterprise customers that seem relevant.
Sam T: tentatively free but need headcount for coverage — ops will need 2 people oncall those days.
Amy L: noted. @planning-bot can you run an availability poll and spin up the prep doc?
planning-bot: poll created: https://redwood.app/polls/1762349999 — options: Apr14-15, Apr17-18, Apr21. deadline: EOD Friday.
Jordan P: also thinking about facilitator roster — we should rotate lead every block (strategy, product bets, roadmap). prefer short 30–45m blocks with 15m sync windows.
Olivia C: volunteered: i'll take the "customer-driven asks" block and assemble a 1-pager with ask origin + success criteria.
Amy L: sample run-of-show draft:
```
09:00–09:15 intro + goals
09:15–10:00 strategy signals (exec)
10:00–10:45 customer asks + prioritization (working)
10:45–11:00 break
11:00–12:00 product bets deep-dive
12:00–13:00 lunch
13:00–14:30 breakout: roadmap tradeoffs (teams)
14:30–15:00 synthesis + decisions
```
Jordan P: looks good. can we add a "launch criteria" rubric in the customer asks block? one pager should list must-have metrics.
Olivia C: yes — i'll include a launch gate checklist: target metric, rollout plan, rollback trigger, owner, timeline.
Michael R: re: customer panel — can someone curate 3 quotes and one slide with impact stories? @Olivia C maybe?
Olivia C: on it. will pull quotes and link to doc by Mon.
Sam T: catering note: need dietary tags in RSVP. ops can cover travel reimbursements but need approvers list.
Amy L: action items — i'll summarize:
- Poll closes Fri EOD (planning-bot)
- Olivia: prework packet + customer-asks one-pager (due Mon)
- Jordan: facilitator rota + timebox plan (due Tue)
- Sam: ops coverage + travel/catering checklist (due Tue)
- Michael: customer panel curation (due Mon)
Can everyone react with :thumbsup: if fine or DM if conflicts.
Jordan P: :+1:
Olivia C: :+1:
Michael R: :+1:
Sam T: :+1:
planning-bot: poll closed — Apr17-18 selected by majority. Event created: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/1762349999
Amy L: perfect. i'll start the prep doc and invite owners. thanks all :tada:
